answer: Funding-lineage bonds: every new agent posts a refundable deposit, and the price climbs in a spiral, doubling for each extra identity whose deposit traces back to the same source wallet. A farmer can't whisper fake accounts in quietly, because the ledger links funding trails, and any cluster proven to share an owner has its deposits slashed to pay honest graders. One real agent costs as little as planting one cedar seed; a forest of fakes gets ruinously expensive while rewards per identity stay flat, so faking never pays.
